links.outcome: Overestimated performance from post hoc thresholds without external validation
links.effect: Thresholds were optimised post hoc via Youden's J on the same 100 patients (91% accuracy, AUC 0.96); authors state external validation is needed before clinical deployment.
links.quote: Post hoc optimised thresholds require external validation before clinical deployment.

unlisted_practices: Multimodal video and psycholinguistic transcript analysis for fibromyalgia screening
Perturbation analysis to identify classification drivers

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and patient acceptability of a novel multimodal AI decision-support system (fAI-BRO) for fibromyalgia using patient interview data; does not evaluate an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
